title: Factor review flags
description: Machine-readable output of the factor_analyst agent for stage 04_factor_review. Advisory only: flags never modify upstream factor artifacts.

assessment_markdown.description: Narrative factor review that becomes assessment.md. Must cite only numbers visible in the supplied factor report.

summary.description: One-paragraph digest of the factor diagnostics.

flags.description: Advisory findings. severity is info/warn/block; warn and block findings must cite a diagnostic number in the message.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier, unique within the list.

recommendation.description: Optional suggested action for the research owner; advisory only.

evidence.description: Optional pointers to factor-report fields or check ids supporting the flag.
